tiles.modelNote: Electricity consumption and production are estimates. Energie Reporter uses a model to divide values measured for all of Switzerland among the municipalities. For consumption the average deviation is about 21 percent, for production between 10 and 40 percent.

tariffs.futureNote: ElCom publishes next year's tariffs months ahead. These years are shown lighter, because what you pay today is still this year's tariff.
